name: perform-nav-zoned
note: S-PERFORM-ZONE (operator UAT 2026-07-17: 'make it easy for single hand usage while performing without having to pick a button in the middle'). In the fullscreen perform view the ADVANCE control (Next / finish) is the one button tapped constantly mid-song, so it must be the DOMINANT bottom-right thumb target, not an equal half. Assert #pNext is >= 2x the width of #pPrev. Setup: seed a saved custom song with a sheet, open it, tap the Stage button (#stageBtn) to enter the perform view. Red-first: pre-fix the two nav buttons were equal (flex:1 each) so the ratio assert FAILS.

steps.label: seed a saved custom song with a two-section sheet so the perform view has content
steps.js: (function(){try{localStorage.setItem('roadcase-ukulele-gcea.custom.v1', JSON.stringify([{id:'perfZoneSong', t:'Perform Zone Song', a:'Me', y:2026, d:'Mine', custom:true, seq:['C','G','Am','F'], sheet:[['Verse','[C] a [G] b [Am] c [F] d'],['Chorus','[C] e [G] f [Am] g [F] h']]}]));return true}catch(e){return false}})()

steps.label: Next is the dominant bottom-right target: at least 2x the width of Prev (FAILS on the pre-fix equal-halves layout)
Next sits on the right of Prev (bottom-right thumb arc)

RED GOALPOST (volley-1): #pPrev is a real, hittable target - >= 44px both axes, non-transparent background, and its own center point hit-tests to itself (catches a transparent or occluded back button, which width/order asserts cannot)
steps.js: (function(){var b=document.getElementById('pPrev');if(!b)return false;var r=b.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.width<1||r.height<1)return false;if(r.width<44||r.height<44)return false;var cs=getComputedStyle(b);if(cs.visibility==='hidden'||parseFloat(cs.opacity)<0.99)return false;var m=/rgba?\(([^)]+)\)/.exec(cs.backgroundColor);if(!m)return false;var parts=m[1].split(',').map(parseFloat);var alpha=parts.length>3?parts[3]:1;if(alpha<0.5)return false;var hit=document.elementFromPoint(r.left+r.width/2,r.top+r.height/2);return !!(hit&&(hit===b||b.contains(hit)));})()

steps.label: #pNext is not overlapped by #pPrev (deterministic stacking: the two nav boxes must not intersect)
the Stage settings popover is open (precondition - its buttons are zero-box while closed, and a zero box would fake-pass any geometry test)
RED GOALPOST (volley-1): every VISIBLE .pSpeed .psBtn clears the 44px tap-target floor (measured 33px pre-fix at 412x915; zero-box buttons are skipped first so a hidden control cannot fake a pass)
the settings popover paints ABOVE the nav bar where they meet (z-index is explicit, not DOM-order accident)
no horizontal overflow at 412px with the popover open
